name: Field Lab Protocol
description: A wasteland scientist needs your help brewing a combat compound.|The settlement's field lab is running dry. Assist with reagent prep and you'll unlock chem station access for advanced mixtures.

text: Seeker, I need hands in this lab right now.
I am formulating a combat compound for frontline crews.
With the right mix, it boosts response, focus, and survivability.
If you assist, I'll grant you full chem station access.
No secrets, no old-world myths—just volatile science.
Start by preparing one of my field-grade mixtures.
